div.head: CHAP. III.

q.p: Verſe 1. THere was a man of the Phariſees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jewes.
2. The ſame came to Jeſus by night, and ſaid unto him, Rabbi, we know that then art a Teacher come from God: f • r no man can do theſe miracles that thou doeſt, except God be with him.

epigraph.q: Ver. 3. Jeſus anſwered, and ſaid unto him, Verily, verily I ſay unto thee, except a man be borne againe, hee cannot ſee the kingdom if God.

p.hi: Followeth the conference it ſelf, and Chriſts inſtructing of this Phariſee; wherein, firſt, he preſſeth the neceſſity of regeneration,
